title: Fake Detention Notice
scenario: A text says you have detention unless you click to appeal immediately.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Fake Detention Notice: the trap is to make speed feel safer than verification. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Discipline notices should come through school or parent channels.
